# Interaction Club

> Interaction Club is a relationship coordination platform for turning a small group of strangers into a recurring friend group through small, concierge-built Tables that can become Circles.

## Canonical Project

- Repository: https://github.com/billionairebumblebee/interaction
- App framework: Next.js
- Primary app route: app/page.tsx
- Admin console: app/admin/
- Product docs: docs/
- Data/application logic: lib/concierge.ts

## Product Purpose

Interaction Club removes the awkward parts of making a plan with new people. The MVP asks whether Interaction can reliably turn a small group of strangers into a recurring friend group.

The first version focuses on:

- Open-beta onboarding.
- Concierge-built four-to-six-person Tables.
- RSVP, attendance, and feedback.
- Circle creation when a Table works.
- Second-meetup planning and referrals.
- Free friend-finding and affordable public-venue Berkeley hangouts.

The product deliberately avoids permanent DMs, public feeds, payments, reservations, bill splitting, restaurant partnerships, identity verification, background checks, and duo tables in the MVP.

## Data And Safety Stance

Interaction collects only what makes a plan work: formal invitation name, broad base area, age band, email, availability, activity preferences, budget, and optional comfort/accessibility details. It does not ask for addresses, sell profile data, or use preferences for price discrimination.

Users should meet in public, pay their own way, and leave if something feels wrong. Product copy should stay clear that Interaction does not verify, background-check, or endorse participants.

## Developer Notes

- Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
- Local dev: `npm install` then `npm run dev`
- Production check: `npm run build`
- Vercel deployment uses the Next.js preset plus private Vercel Blob storage for application JSON records.
